BiblicalUsage: Menowrah is the lampstand, the chandelier of the tabernacle and the temple, and its light never went out in God's house. 1 Chronicles 28:15 weighs the gold for every candlestick by its use, and 1 Kings 7:49 sets five candlesticks of pure gold on the right and five on the left before the oracle. 2 Chronicles 4:7 makes ten candlesticks of gold according to their form, and 2 Kings 4:10 puts a candlestick in the little chamber the Shunammite built for Elisha.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the lampstand is the picture of a light that is kept, not made: gold by weight, set in its place, burning where God said. My position is that the church is that lampstand now, and its job is still to hold the light where people can see it.
